green-season-video-competition-2026.title: Video Competition – "Visit Cambodia in Green Season 2026"
green-season-video-competition-2026.description: Create promotional videos highlighting Cambodia's tourism potential and natural beauty under the Green Season 2026 theme.
green-season-video-competition-2026.requirement: Video submission before deadline, 18 years old and above.
green-season-video-competition-2026.benefit: 1st Place: 8,000,000 Riels + trophy, certificate, gifts/vouchers, Creator Ambassador title, and LED/billboard promo. 2nd Place: 4,000,000 Riels + trophy. 3rd Place: 2,000,000 Riels + trophy. Top 10 special category awards & souvenirs for all participants.
highlights: 8,000,000 KHR First Prize & National Broadcast
Official Creator Ambassador designation from Ministry of Tourism
Nationwide billboard and digital LED promotion

journey-beyond-workshop-tsa.benefit: Build connections with senior students and alumni from diverse tech majors; learn insider tips for scholarship applications; receive practical academic advice.

Application roadmap for Cambodian top scholarships
Interactive Q&A session with alumni across engineering & tech

free-ux-ui-workshop-siem-reap.title: Free UX/UI Workshop in Siem Reap

cambodia-nationwide-odoo-rupp-pitch-cup.title: Cambodia Nationwide Odoo × RUPP Pitch Cup

highlights: $2,400 USD total cash prize pool
Official Odoo ERP business software certification
Direct recruitment opportunities with leading tech sponsors

8-week-leadership-journey-iatss-japan.title: 8-Week Leadership Journey in Japan
8-week-leadership-journey-iatss-japan.description: Eight-week prestigious international leadership development program taking place in Japan focused on climate justice, sustainable policy, and human security.
8-week-leadership-journey-iatss-japan.requirement: National of Cambodia; aged 35 or under; at least 2 years of full-time professional experience; available for May–July 2027 or September–November 2027.
8-week-leadership-journey-iatss-japan.benefit: Fully funded 8-week leadership program in Japan including flights, accommodation, and stipend. Field studies in Yokkaichi, Hiroshima, and Kamaishi.
highlights: 100% Fully Funded international scholarship to Japan
Field research in Hiroshima on human security & climate justice
Lifelong international alumni network across ASEAN & Japan

nava-thon-season-4-climate-architecture.title: NAVA-Thon Season 4: Architectural Prototype

nava-thon-season-4-climate-architecture.requirement: No requirement — open to youth, architecture students, and young climate advocates.
nava-thon-season-4-climate-architecture.benefit: Build and test physical architectural prototypes for school cooling; expand network with architects & climate experts; receive real project seed funding.
highlights: Seed funding to build your eco-architectural prototype
Mentorship from leading Cambodian sustainable architects
Real-world climate impact for local public schools

Master academic citation styles (APA, MLA, IEEE)
Digital media verification & scam fact-checking methods
